description: Create a call asset (phone number) and attach it to a campaign so ads can show a call button. Refs #5764.

campaignId.description: Campaign to attach the call extension to.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number in national format, e.g. "415-555-0100".

name: gads_add_call_extension
